scope: Analytic phantom calibration and fixed TRAIN36 partial oracle support; no efficacy result

fixed_fit24_log_radius_reference.source: StoredFP32 log(radius_mm/1mm); within-case supported-site moments then equal24 cases

definitions.support: A1 only when original sparse-radius nonjunction support passes native-radius/FOV/nearest-value-identifiability checks
definitions.unknown: A0/state255 is unsupported, not known background; R0 is neutral storage, not radius0
definitions.denominator: Support/reason fractions use all nominal64^3 sites; each case has16 patches,8 per sampler stratum
definitions.radius_statistics: Only A1 sites enter radius/logR distributions; pooled site distributions are labeled and do not count sites as independent samples
definitions.averaging: Coverage case-equal. Within-patch variance uses supported patches only, then case equal; all unsupported patch rows retained as null
definitions.reasons: Overlapping reason flags, not exclusive causes or causal loss attribution; fractions need not sum to1
definitions.half_ring: Within each patch ownA1 C-order list, roll floor(N/2); preserve support and exact stored radius multiset; no donor selection
definitions.normalized_change: Descriptive CPU reconstruction of F64 normalization then FP32; actual GPU response belongs to the separate pilot
definitions.query_grid: Nominal .5+2u cache-voxel centers for64^3 grid and128 patch; not a proved receptive-field center
definitions.analytic_error: Proxy minus known analytic axis radius; Lee offsets separately reflect rasterization, NN resampling and thinning; not a Lee-only causal error
